units.en: We already saw that when a C operand is a power of 2, it uses shifts instead of multiplies/divides, but this shows that in other cases, it uses multiply or divide instructions.
units.ja: C のオペランドが 2 の累乗のときは、乗除算ではなくシフトを使うことは見た。ここでは、それ以外の場合に乗算・除算命令を使うことが分かる。

units.en: Unsigned divide ax by r/m8, al = quotient, ah = remainder
units.ja: ax を r/m8 で符号なし除算。al = 商、ah = 余り

units.en: Unsigned divide edx:eax by r/m32, eax = quotient, edx = remainder
units.ja: edx:eax を r/m32 で符号なし除算。eax = 商、edx = 余り

units.en: Unsigned divide rdx:rax by r/m64, rax = quotient, rdx = remainder
units.ja: rdx:rax を r/m64 で符号なし除算。rax = 商、rdx = 余り

units.en: If dividend is 32/64bits, edx/rdx will just be set to 0 by the compiler before the instruction (as occurred in the MulDivExample.c code)
units.ja: 被除数が 32/64 ビットの場合、命令の前にコンパイラが edx/rdx を 0 にする(MulDivExample.c のコードで見たとおり)

units.en: If the divisor is 0, a divide by zero exception is raised.
units.ja: 除数が 0 の場合は、ゼロ除算例外が発生する。

units.en: Note that there’s no form which takes an immediate.
units.ja: 即値をとる形はない点に注意。

units.en: If you were to then change MulDivExample to signed, you would see the IDIV instruction appear
units.ja: MulDivExample を符号つきに変えると、IDIV 命令が現れる

units.en: Signed divide ax by r/m8, al = quotient, ah = remainder
units.ja: ax を r/m8 で符号つき除算。al = 商、ah = 余り

units.en: Signed divide edx:eax by r/mX, eax = quotient, edx = remainder
units.ja: edx:eax を r/mX で符号つき除算。eax = 商、edx = 余り

units.en: Signed divide rdx:rax by r/m64, rax = quotient, rdx = remainder
units.ja: rdx:rax を r/m64 で符号つき除算。rax = 商、rdx = 余り

units.en: If dividend is 32/64bits, edx/rdx will just be set to 0 by the compiler before the instruction
units.ja: 被除数が 32/64 ビットの場合、命令の前にコンパイラが edx/rdx を 0 にする

units.en: If the divisor is 0, a divide by zero exception is raised.
units.ja: 除数が 0 の場合は、ゼロ除算例外が発生する。

units.en: Note that there’s no form which takes an immediate.
units.ja: 即値をとる形はない点に注意。

units.en: When a multiply or divide is not by a power of 2, compilers will use normal multiply/divide instructions
units.ja: 2 の累乗以外での乗算・除算では、コンパイラは通常の乗算・除算命令を使う

units.en: VS compiler prefers IMUL over MUL (unsigned multiply)
units.ja: VS のコンパイラは、MUL(符号なし乗算)より IMUL を好む
